note: Cross-cutting optional fields shared by every upsert_*_widget operation in this directory: widget.actions, widget.dynamicTokens, and the style/receive-source/conditional-formatting building blocks several widgets' parameters reference by name below. This file is not an operation itself — read it alongside whichever upsert_*_widget.json you're using when you need one of these fields. Everything here is optional; omitting it is always valid.

widgetLevelFields.description: Every widget type also accepts an optional top-level widget.description (human-readable, distinct from widget.label). Omitted from the per-widget files for brevity — assume it's always available.

actions.description: Interactions triggered by the widget on click or select. Each item is one of the 5 action types below, discriminated by actionType.

dynamicTokens.description: Dynamic tokens keyed by token name, referenced elsewhere on the widget (e.g. from text content, or a metric's tokenSpec).

tokenSpec.description: Shape depends on type; keyed by setting name.

parameters.label: string, optional
parameters.includeState: boolean, optional — carry current dashboard filter/parameter state into the destination
parameters.destination: NavigateDestination — oneOf: {type:"url", target} | {type:"page", target} | {type:"dashboard", target, pageName} | {type:"metricdetails", target:{tokenName}}

parameters.flowName: string — API name of the flow to run
parameters.attributes: object keyed by flow variable name -> FlowAttribute { inputDataType, inputData: {inputType:"static", value} | {inputType:"dynamic", widgetId, widgetField, selectionType: "result"|"selection"} }

parameters.parameter: value to set on the target parameter widget

ContainerStyle.background: BackgroundParameters — { alignmentX, alignmentY, imageScale: fitToWidth|fitToHeight|fill|original, opacity: 0-100 }

receiveFilterSource.publishers: [{ widgetId, fieldName, objectName, source:{id,name} }], optional — explicit FilterPublisher list

ConditionalFormattingRule.name: string
ConditionalFormattingRule.formatBasedOn: string — field or value the rule keys on

ConditionalFormattingBucket.operator: greater_than | greater_than_or_equal_to | less_than | less_than_or_equal_to | equals | between
ConditionalFormattingBucket.attributes: TextContentAttributes — the styling applied when this bucket matches
